topic: The Early Stuarts & the Origins of the Civil War 1603-1660
subject: history

items.q: How did the conflict between Charles I and Parliament end?
items.correct: In civil war (1642–49); Charles I was executed in 1649.
items.random_wrong: Charles I won and ruled unopposed.
items.why: Disputes over power, money and religion led to war and the king's execution.

items.correct: No — he ruled as Lord Protector and even refused the crown.
items.why: After the monarchy was abolished, Cromwell led as Lord Protector.
